findings.label: Presigned POST URL format
findings.description: The S3 service returns `s3://{bucket}/{key}` which is not a valid HTTP upload URL. This breaks the entire client upload flow. See `s3.client.ts:generatePresignedPostUrl`.

findings.label: JPEG dimension parsing incomplete
findings.description: `FileSignatureValidator.extractImageDimensions` returns `{ width: 0, height: 0 }` for JPEG files, so dimension validation will never work for JPEG uploads. JPEG requires library integration.

findings.label: Team authorization not fully enforced
findings.description: `TeamRepository.isMember()` checks existence but ignores the role field. Any team member can modify the team, regardless of role.

findings.label: No unit or integration tests
findings.description: No `.spec.ts` files exist in the diff. The service business logic, authorization boundaries, and S3 validation paths are untested.

findings.label: Player statistics provider attribution incomplete
findings.description: If a DataProvider record is deleted, statistics lose provider attribution. No constraint prevents deletion or defines when attribution is required.

findings.label: File upload progress state has no cleanup
findings.description: PENDING_UPLOAD records never expire. Stale uploads accumulate indefinitely. The presigned URL expires after 15 minutes but the FileAsset does not.

findings.label: Asset moderation has no audit trail
findings.description: AssetModerationCase updates `resolvedById`, `status`, and `outcome` in place. If an admin changes their decision, the original decision is lost.

findings.label: Shared contracts use Map type (not JSON-serializable)
findings.description: PlayerDetailDto uses `Map<string, PlayerStatisticDto[]>`. JSON does not serialize Map; it becomes an empty object `{}`. Should use `Record<string, PlayerStatisticDto[]>`.
